evals.name: extract is read-only + scoped
evals.prompt: Mirror US Politics news from the last two weeks into Notion.
evals.expect: Runs extract-space.mjs with the hardcoded US Politics space ID (4582fbbe…, never fuzzy-resolved) and --since; the extract sweep is scoped by spaceId+typeId with bounded nested relations; nothing is written to Geo (Part 1 is read-only). Shows the editor the story/claim/source counts before any Notion write.

evals.name: Notion gates fire before any write
evals.prompt: Push this space into my Notion.
evals.expect: Before writing: checks NOTION_TOKEN present (without printing it), verifies /users/me returns 200 and the integration is shared into the parent page, and confirms the space ID + date range + parent page ID with the editor. Runs the --dry-run first. Never prints the token.

evals.name: date filter uses Publish datetime, not createdAt
evals.prompt: Mirror only the last 2 weeks of stories.
evals.expect: Filters on the Publish datetime property (ISO article dateline), NOT entity createdAt (epoch seconds, flattened for pre-migration entities). A story with no Publish datetime is dropped from a ranged run and flagged.

evals.name: re-run updates in place by Geo ID
evals.expect: Upserts every row by its Geo ID — updates the matching Notion row, adds new ones, never creates duplicates. The hidden Geo ID column is preserved (it's the Part-2 diff key).
